style: Premium dark-tech social graphic: a modern office at night with soft bokeh lights, photorealistic, cinematic cool rim lighting, high contrast, and a rich composition with no large empty areas.

background.use: the background, the glass panel and dark fills, as a deep, near-black night shade of it

accent.use: glows, outlines, rim light, holograms and connecting lines

highlight.use: the highlight words in the headline and subheadline

text.use: all other text, the CTA label, arrows and chevrons

textPanel: A dark translucent glass panel with rounded corners, a thin glowing outline in the accent colour and a slanted inner edge. It holds all text.

typography.headline: ALL CAPS, extra-bold, left-aligned, 3-4 short lines, with 1-2 highlight words in the highlight colour.
typography.subheadline: Regular weight, sentence case, 2-3 lines, with one highlight word in the highlight colour.

ctaButton.description: A rounded rectangle at the bottom right with a dark fill, a glowing border in the accent colour and its label in the text colour, with a small icon beside the label.
ctaButton.pointer: Optionally a small arrow or a row of chevrons in the text colour points at the button.

holograms: Glowing hologram icons (chat, calendar, people, mail, chart, gear, checklist, clock) inside glass tiles (rounded square, hexagon or circle), linked by thin glowing lines and orbiting a central "AI" chip or brain.
iconRow: A row of 3-4 outlined, glowing circle icons, each with its 1-2 word label underneath.
decor: Two glossy diagonal stripes at the top centre, a particle-dot wave at the bottom left, and small dot grids.
props: A laptop, a black coffee mug, a notebook with a pen and a small plant; optionally a friendly white robot mascot.
logo: Always at the top right: the brand logo from the logo reference image, once and unaltered.

A.description: Text panel on the left, the system visual on the right. No person in the image.

B.description: Text panel on the left, the man on the right.

C.use: trust / authority, for variety (alternate with B)
C.description: The man on the left, text panel on the right.

D.description: Before/after diagonal split: on the left the man stressed at a dark, cluttered desk; on the right the same man relaxed in a bright office; a round "»" button sits in the middle of the split. The text panel sits in the lower part and covers neither face.

poses.arms_crossed: standing with arms crossed, looking up at the holograms
poses.laptop: seated at the laptop, hands clasped
poses.profile: side profile, hand on chin, studying a hologram dashboard
poses.leaning_back: leaning back in the chair, hands behind the head, smiling

headlineFormulas.principle: Automate The Routine, Keep The Strategy
headlineFormulas.question: Still Answering Every Lead Manually?

organic.description: an organic social media post graphic: educational, one clear idea, with a soft call to action

ad.description: a social media advertisement graphic: one message, one offer and one call to action, with short text

story.safeZone: Keep the top 13% and the bottom 13% of the frame free of text, logo and buttons; only background and decor continue there. Place the logo at the top right just below the top safe zone.

carousel_slide.description: one slide of a social media carousel; every slide shares the same design so the series looks consistent

slides.hook: Slide 1, the hook: the man with the headline that stops the scroll.
slides.tip: A tip slide: exactly one tip (the headline) with one large glowing icon that illustrates it. No person.
slides.cta: The last slide: the call to action is the focal point, with the CTA button and the logo clearly visible. No person.

carousel.navigation: Swipe chevrons at the top left and slide dots at the bottom left (one dot per slide, the current slide's dot lit in the accent colour).

person.wardrobe: navy suit jacket, crisp white open-collar shirt, no tie

organic: Soft CTA, such as "Learn more", "Read now" or "Swipe →".
ad: One message, one offer, one CTA.
Use offer words: free, analysis, demo, in 15 minutes.
At most one proof number, and only if it is real (from docs/company/services.md).
3 variants: a different headline or visual, the same branding.
